mutations.name: a tags/ or v<digit> segment anywhere in a destination reads as a tag
kills: normal work classifies nothing git push to a branch whose name holds tags/

mutations.name: a readHead that throws reads as no branch checked out
kills: one fixture per bash.merge spelling a readHead that throws reads as an unknown protected head git push origin HEAD
one fixture per bash.merge spelling a readHead that throws reads as an unknown protected head git merge x

mutations.name: an unknown gh path is read only for a literal pr merge
kills: a gh command whose group or verb is only known at run time reads gh $X as a merge of an unknown PR
a gh command whose group or verb is only known at run time reads gh pr $X 5 as a merge of an unknown PR

mutations.name: an unknown gh path does not switch the branch
kills: a gh command whose group or verb is only known at run time reads it as a switch to an unknown head, so a later push counts as protected

mutations.name: a dynamic command word read as gh ignores a run-time word
kills: a gh command whose group or verb is only known at run time reads a run-time verb behind a dynamic command word as a gh merge
